== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Zakareth]] is the [[King of Damasca]] and a [[Traveler of Ragnarus]]. His lineage holds the unique ability to open the Gate to his territory, though access requires more than just being a [[blood]] descendant. Historically, the first ruler of [[Damasca]] used his [[Traveler]] abilities to seal away a dangerous force to protect the kingdom. [[Zakareth]] is a figure of significant power, capable of commanding [[Incarnations]] and wielding weapons such as a [[ruby]]-topped staff and a spear. His physical appearance has undergone dramatic changes due to [[Incarnation]], resulting in skin patterned with gold and [[ruby]], a [[stone]] eye replaced by a crimson fireball, and hair containing red or gold strands. He wears black armor accented with gold and rubies. [[Zakareth]] is a determined leader who seeks to bring [[Enosh]] under his control and has faced betrayal from his own son and a daughter who was unprepared for her royal role. Despite facing defeat, he maintains confidence in his eventual return.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The King is a figure who issues orders to his men and maintains an interest in receiving news from [[Kai]]. He has been subject to distractions caused by [[Zakareth]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The King possesses the power to seal [[Dragon's Fang|Dragon's Fangs]] within the Vault.}}
